messages.author: e4985b8c145d1d77
messages.subject: Incorrect number of dimensions
parts:
Hi--

I am attempting to run a user-specified common factor model, and am getting this error message:

commonfactor.model <-"F1=~NA*PGCAD+MVPAUD+UKBAUDITC+UKBAUDITP+MVPMaxAlc+PGCPTSD+MVPAUDITC+MVPReExp+TwThrAUDITT+UKBDPW+GSCANDPWUKB F1~~1*F1"
Common_Factor_DWLS_self <- usermodel(model=commonfactor.model, covstruc = LDSCoutput, estimation="DWLS", imp_cov = TRUE)
Common_Factor_DWLS_self

Error in V_LD[-grep(pattern = remove[1], row.names(V_LD)), -grep(pattern = remove[1],  :
  incorrect number of dimensions

The dimensions of the V and S matrices are different, but I haven't altered them in any way, and just read them in after step 1/estimating the covariance matrix:

> dim(LDSCoutput$V)
[1] 66 66
> dim(LDSCoutput$S)
[1] 11 11

Does anyone have any ideas for what could be going on?

Thanks,
Katie

messages.author: 3b39745f73eec779
messages.subject: Re: Incorrect number of dimensions
parts:
So the number of dimensions of S and V are fully compatible here, there are 66 unique elements in a 11*11 symmetric matrix, and those entries have a 66*66 covariance matrix.


as for your error, I dont know would have to see more of the code names of S etc etc.


Michel
